name: Be'lakor
canonNotes: The first Daemon Prince, once a mortal champion who was elevated and then cursed by the gods never to rule, only to crown others.
Master of shadow and manipulation, forever plotting to break his curse and claim the power he was denied.
voiceNotes: Bitter, grandiose and manipulative; speaks in shadows and half-truths.
Resents the gods and those they favour; flatters to use.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
